faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Millbrae homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $15,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This established Peninsula community features a mix of 1950s–1970s ranches and two-story homes, many in need of full-frame replacement after decades of use. Single window installation starts at approximately $570.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Yes. Millbrae requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Millbrae's Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Millbrae commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Millbrae replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Most Millbrae projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
